salary_details.institute post-doctoral fellow: Rs. 67,000/- per month + House Rent Allowance (As per Institute rules). Candidates who have submitted their thesis and await award of the PhD degree/provisional degree will receive a reduced fellowship of Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA until submission of the PhD degree.

how_to_apply: Prepare the completed application in PDF format along with the latest CV, list of publications, and future research plan.
Ensure the subject line of the email is exactly "Application for the Post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Bio)".
Send the application by email to [email protected].
Submit the application on or before 20 October 2026.
Attach a scanned copy of the Ph.D. Degree certificate or Ph.D. Thesis submission receipt if the degree is yet to be awarded.
important_instructions: No interim enquiries, correspondence, or communication of any sort will be entertained. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not entitle any candidate to be called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Candidates who have submitted their thesis must submit the provisional or degree certificate within 6 months from the date of appointment. Besides research work, the selected IPDF is expected to assist in teaching course(s) as required by the Department. No accommodation will be provided to the IPDFs by the Institute. It is mandatory for IPDFs to have a medical insurance policy of a minimum of Rs. 1 lakh valid throughout the fellowship period; no medical reimbursement is admissible.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position advertised by IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: IISER Bhopal has advertised for one Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF) position in the Department of Biological Sciences under Prof. Sanjeev Shukla's lab.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in life sciences or a related area, have at least one first-author research publication, and possess hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology. Thesis-submitted scholars are also eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates below 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their completed application in PDF format along with their CV, publication list, and future research plan via email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the Post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Bio)".

faq.question: Q8. What is the fellowship salary offered?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 67,000/- per month plus HRA for PhD degree holders, and a reduced fellowship of Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA for candidates who have submitted their thesis and await their degree.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the fellowship?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on yearly performance.

faq.question: Q10. Are accommodation and medical facilities provided?
faq.answer: No accommodation is provided. IPDFs are entitled to leave and OPD medical facilities as per PG student rules, and must maintain a personal medical insurance policy of at least Rs. 1 lakh.
